request.prompt:
Goods: Combination spanner set, chrome vanadium steel
Country of origin: TW

Chosen so far: 82 Tools, implements, cutlery, spoons and forks, of base metal; parts thereof, of base metal

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 8204: Tools, hand; hand-operated spanners and wrenches (including torque meter wrenches but not including tap wrenches), interchangeable spanner sockets, with or without handles
    contains 820420: Tools, hand; interchangeable spanner sockets, with or without handles
    contains 820412: Tools, hand; hand-operated spanners and wrenches (including torque meter wrenches but not including tap wrenches), adjustable
    contains 820411: Tools, hand; hand-operated spanners and wrenches (including torque meter wrenches but not including tap wrenches), non-adjustable
- 8206: Tools, hand; two or more of heading no. 8202 to 8205, put up in sets for retail sale
    contains 820600: Tools, hand; two or more of heading no. 8202 to 8205, put up in sets for retail sale
- 8205: Tools, hand; (including glaziers' diamonds) n.e.c.; blow lamps; vices, clamps etc, other than accessories for and parts of, machine-tools or water-jet cutting machines; anvils; portable forges; hand or pedal operated grinding wheels with frameworks
    contains 820540: Tools, hand; screwdrivers
    contains 820570: Tools, hand; vices, clamps and the like
    contains 820590: Tools, hand; n.e.c. in heading 8205, including anvils, portable forges, hand or pedal-operated grinding wheels with frameworks, and sets of articles of two or more of the subheadings in heading 8205
- 8203: Tools, hand; files, rasps, pliers (including cutting pliers), pincers, tweezers, metal cutting shears, pipe cutters, bolt croppers, perforating punches and similar
    contains 820320: Tools, hand; pliers (including cutting pliers), pincers, tweezers and similar tools
    contains 820310: Tools, hand; files, rasps and similar tools
- 8207: Tools, interchangeable; for hand tools, whether or not power-operated, or for machine tools (pressing, stamping, punching, drilling etc), including dies for drawing or extruding metal, and rock drilling or earth boring tools
    contains 820790: Tools, interchangeable; (for machine or hand tools, whether or not power-operated), for screw-driving or uses n.e.c. in heading no. 8207

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: A combination spanner set made up solely of spanners falls under 8204 as hand-operated non-adjustable spanners; 8206 requires tools from two or more of headings 8202-8205, and 8204 spanners are all within a single heading.</br>
